label: H.R. 10371
title: Ensuring SBA Implementation of GAO Recommendations Act of 2026
short_title: Ensuring SBA Implementation of GAO Recommendations Act of 2026

latest_action.text: Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.

summary: Ensuring SBA Implementation of GAO Recommendations Act of 2026 This bill requires the Office of Veterans Business Development within the Small Business Administration (SBA) to develop and implement policies and procedures to ensure compliance with existing reporting requirements related to veteran-owned small businesses. Specifically, such policies must ensure the SBA complies and submits an annual report on the needs of small businesses owned and controlled by veterans, including service-disabled veterans. Such reports must also include proposals to improve the access of such businesses to government assistance.
summary_short: Requires the Office of Veterans Business Development within the Small Business Administration (SBA) to develop and implement policies and procedures to ensure compliance with existing reporting requirements related to veteran-owned small businesses.
